snippet.title: Hungry Horrors - Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Hungry Horrors is out now in Early Access.

Hungry Horrors is a folklore-inspired card game where feeding Horrors is the core of your strategy. Face creatures from British and Irish legends and use real regional dishes as cards to manage hunger, cravings, and difficult choices.

Play as a lost princess travelling through a strange kingdom, meeting mythical Horrors drawn from real folklore, each with their own tastes, preferences, and consequences. Every run teaches you more about how to feed them, and what happens when you get it wrong.

Early Access marks the start of the journey. The game will continue to grow with new content, balance updates, and improvements shaped by player feedback.

Wishlist or play now to join Early Access.
